newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-14 UNCAPPED PLAYERS FOR ARGENTINA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-14 UNCAPPED PLAYERS FOR ARGENTINA.

text.p: England have named 14 uncapped players in their squad who fly to Argentina next month for a six-match tour.
With 18 English players included in the British Lions tour to South Africa, the selectors have a perfect chance to assess English strength in depth ahead of the 1999 World Cup.
Regular captain Phil de Glanville, not picked for the Lions tour, is selected for Argentina.
Argentina almost scored their first victory at Twickenham last December against a full strength England side and the teams drew 1-1 when England last played the Pumas away from home.
England have named 29 players and another winger is expected to be added by the end of next week.

Backs: Jim Mallinder, Mark Mapletoft, Adedayo Adebayo, Matt Allen, Jos Baxendall, Jon Sleightholme, David Rees, Phil de Glanville (captain), Nick Greenstock, Mike Catt, Alex King, Kyran Bracken, Andy Gomarsall, A.N. Other.

Forwards: Ben Clarke, Martin Corry, Tony Diprose, Chris Sheasby, Rory Jenkins, Steve Ojomoh, Garath Archer, Martin Bayfield, John Fowler, Martin Haag, Rob Hardwick, Darren Garforth, John Mallett, Kevin Yates, Phil Greening, Richard Cockerill.
